description: Named the sallow and the east wind.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Called a cap no church, and turned the house toward home.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Sat in the Mayor's pew with his hand on the door, and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Preached the fickle crowd, named thirty years without palms, and looked at nobody.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Read the line, and added nothing.
name: William Shakespeare
